title: Artificial intelligence can match domain experts in evidence extraction and critical appraisal of microbial oncogenesis research publications

live_model.evidence: Sec 2.3: "GPT-5 model API snapshots gpt-5-2025-08-07 and gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07"; Sec 3.3.5.1: GPT-5 Nano combined overlap score median=2.00 (IQR 1.25-2.00)

prompt.location: Sec 2.2/2.4: "The full extraction template can be found in the Supplementary Material"
prompt.note: Extraction template (questionnaire) is referenced and stated as available (open-access Frontiers supplementary material) but not reproduced in the main text.

claim.metric: combined overlap score, microbial-oncogenesis-criteria questions (0-4 scale, median)
claim.location: Sec 3.3.5.1: "across the six questions analyzed ... GPT-5 Nano having the lowest scores (2.00, IQR 1.25-2.00)"; n = 6 questions x 24 papers

data.source: 24 original research papers on microbial oncogenesis; human-validated test dataset stated available in Supplementary Material

notes: Headline MCQ result (n=336 question instances, Figure 6) is reported only via Wilcoxon test statistics (W, p, r) for GPT-5 Nano, not a plain match-proportion value. GPT-5-2025-08-07 (also live, different CSV row) scores higher on the same combined-overlap metric (3.00).
